versions.content: When called by the RTE, LdCom shall use the Signal Id ("id" parameter in the call) as LdComHandleId (ECUC_LdCom_00005) to look-up the correct LdComIPdu in the LdCom configuration. Using the LdComPduRef configuration parameter (ECUC_LdCom_00010)the corresponding PDU Id in the PduR'S configuration shall be derived. This PDU Id shall then be used when forwarding the call towards the PduR.
